title: Multi-Objective Deep Reinforcement Learning for Crowd Route Guidance Optimization
venue: Transportation Research Record Journal of the Transportation Research Board
abstract: In this study, we propose an improved version of Pareto deep Q-network (PDQN), a multi-objective deep reinforcement learning method, and attempt to demonstrate its effectiveness in a real-world problem such as crowd route guidance strategy optimization. Overcrowding during crowd movement can sometimes lead to accidents; therefore, it is imperative to guide crowds to move safely and efficiently.
